character.name: Sebak
character.title: The Crow in the Wind
character.lineage: Half-Uchiha (Son of Uchiha Itachi) / Unknown Maternal Bloodline

alar.notes: 1 firm Alar binding in combat (scales with Intelligence and University training)

features.name: Body Flicker (Shunshin)
features.description: Teleport/dash up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space you can see without provoking opportunity attacks.

features.name: Chakra-Fuelled Link
features.description: Act as a pure, lossless thermal/kinetic source for a Sympathetic binding for 1 round, bypassing the need for a fire or the risk of Binder's Chills.

features.name: Precision Throw
features.description: Curve a thrown kunai/dagger around half or three-quarters cover, granting Advantage on the attack roll.

features.name: Setting a Binding
features.description: Bonus action to set up, whatever the link quality. Roll an Alar check: d20 + INT + proficiency, plus WIS when focused (lost if you took damage or were grappled since your last turn; advantage after a calm round of preparation). DC by link: Perfect 8, Good 11, Poor 15. A failure means slippage and a partial effect, not a miss. A binding acting on a person lets them save against your Sympathy DC. Maintaining it is free but occupies your one mental split. Shares your bonus action with Body Flicker.

features.name: Link Efficiency
features.description: Perfect Link (same piece of matter): DC 8, ~80-90%. Good Link (similar material, or blood/hair for organic targets): DC 11, ~40-60%. Poor Link (crude similarity): DC 15, ~5-15%, high slippage.

features.name: Binder's Chills
features.description: Drawing heat from your own body requires a CON save (DC 10 + energy level) or take 1d4 cold damage and 1 level of Exhaustion.

features.name: Sneak Attack (1d6)
features.description: Extra 1d6 damage when hitting with a Finesse/Ranged weapon with Advantage, or when an ally (or an active Sympathetic kinetic binding distracting the target) is within 5 ft. of the enemy.

features.name: Uchiha Dormancy (Sharingan)
features.description: The Sharingan is locked. Extreme emotional trauma or life-or-death catalysis may awaken it.

features.name: Unknown Maternal Bloodline
features.description: Passive triggers observed by the DM during high-stress physical or sympathetic events. Surrounding matter hums and vibrates. Stirred at the brink of death at the felled oak: iron and wood within reach rang and the nearest club shattered. It drained his chakra and left him exhausted. Its nature is still unknown.

keepsakes: Small wooden amulet containing a single black crow feather (mother's warning)

world.location: The Commonwealth, three miles south of the Omethi River, on the road between Imre and the University
world.weather: Crisp wind, overcast sky threatening cold rain

companions.name: Bram
companions.notes: Portly tinker driving a mule-drawn wagon from Crosson. Unconscious at 0 HP and still dying (2 death save successes, 2 failures).

encounter.title: Surprise Round: Felled Oak Ambush

enemies.name: Crossbowman
enemies.position: Slumped on an ash branch, 15 ft up
enemies.notes: Still unconscious in the ash tree; crossbow caught in the branch fork

environment: Lit brass whale-oil lantern hanging on Bram's wagon next to Sebak (steady thermal source)

last_log: Sebak found linen, a needle with waxed thread and a flask of spirits in Bram's wagon; Bram is one failed death save from dying.
